inspection.question: Does real-provider validation require a new backend/API contract beyond N7.6?
evidence: N7.6 certifies the WhatsApp HTTP boundary, fail-closed verification, scoped anonymous webhook and authenticated tenant/RBAC configuration endpoints.
It also certifies truthful no-session/no-QR behavior unless supplied by the provider.
N8.6's missing proof is provider execution, not a missing application contract.
inspection.scopeDecision: Causal N/A for backend/API code; N8.6.G must exercise the existing boundary against authorized provider infrastructure.
